sources.citation: Owen AM, Coleman MR, Boly M, Davis MH, Laureys S, Pickard JD. (2006). Detecting awareness in the vegetative state. Science 313(5792):1402.
sources.access_note: 付费墙（Science）；基于摘要、官方科学通讯和引用该论文的开放全文综述
sources.key_finding: 植物状态患者 fMRI 心理意象（网球/房间游览）激活与健康对照相同的皮层区域；开创 CMD 主动范式

sources.citation: Casarotto S, Comanducci A, Rosanova M, et al. (2016). Stratification of unresponsive patients by an independently validated index of brain complexity. Ann Neurol 80(5):718-729.
sources.key_finding: PCI* = 0.31；健康被试 100%/100% 区分；MCS 94.7% 超阈值；VS 21% 高 PCI 组恢复率 67% vs 低 PCI 组 24%

sources.citation: Claassen J, Doyle K, Malone A, et al. (2019). Detection of brain activation in unresponsive patients with acute brain injury. N Engl J Med 380(26):2497-2505.
sources.key_finding: 15%（16/104）急性脑损伤无反应患者 EEG CMD 阳性；12个月恢复率 44% vs 14%（OR=4.6）

sources.citation: Bodien YG, Chatelle C, Edlow BL, et al. (2024). Cognitive motor dissociation in disorders of consciousness. N Engl J Med.
sources.access_note: 付费墙（NEJM）；基于摘要和官方新闻稿
sources.key_finding: 六中心国际研究；241名无反应 DoC 患者中 60人（25%）CMD 阳性；fMRI+EEG 联合最优

sources.citation: Kazazian K, Monti MM, Owen AM. (2025). Functional neuroimaging in disorders of consciousness: towards clinical implementation. Brain 148:awaf075.
sources.key_finding: 仅 8–20% 医疗中心常规开展高级 DoC 神经影像评估；CRS-R 假阴性率 ~20%；技术、成本、专业培训是主要障碍

sources.citation: Giacino JT, Katz DI, Schiff ND, et al. (2018). Comprehensive systematic review update summary: disorders of consciousness. Arch Phys Med Rehabil 99(9):1688-1695.
sources.key_finding: AAN+ACRM+NIDILRR 联合指南；CRS-R 首选；金刚烷胺对 MCS/VS TBI 患者功能恢复有中等证据

sources.citation: Young MJ, Edlow BL, Bodien YG. (2024). Covert consciousness. NeuroRehabilitation 54(1):93-108.
sources.key_finding: 隐蔽意识的操作定义；10–20% 行为无意识患者有隐蔽意识；CMD 定义和检测工具综述

sources.citation: Bodien YG, Busl KM, Chang CWJ, et al. (2025). Disorders of consciousness diagnosis, interventions, and prognostication for the intensivist: Report of the 2025 ISICEM roundtable. Intensive Care Med.
sources.key_finding: 六步临床路线图；CMD 15–25% 流行率；无急性干预改变意识恢复的强证据；伦理框架

sources.citation: Maciejewicz B. (2022). Neuroscience of consciousness in the locked-in syndrome: Prognostic and diagnostic review. iBrain 9(1):39-47.
sources.key_finding: LIS 三种亚型；7% 完全运动恢复；完整大脑皮层和意识；对体现认知理论的挑战

notes: Owen 2006 (Science) 是领域奠基性论文，无法获取全文；Claassen 2019 和 Bodien 2024 均来自 NEJM，付费；其他重要综述（Casarotto 2016, Kazazian 2025, ISICEM 2025）均通过 PMC 开放获取。来自开放来源的信息已足够支撑文章的机制解释和数据引用。
